## Appearance

She is a heavy, stout woman weighing two hundred pounds whose walk is a continuous waddle. Over time, she has developed aged, gentle arms and coarsen-skinned hands from hard labor.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031), [v2 c26 P1](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0001), [v3 c40 P14](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0014)_

## Personality

Agatha Sowerby is a candid, opinionated, and highly pragmatic woman who speaks her mind without hesitation or partiality. Though often meddlesome, critical, and gossipy, she possesses a deeply compassionate, kindly, and generous heart that leads her to serve tirelessly as a caregiver and community worker. She holds firm, unyielding views on morality, religion, and traditional roles, expressing strong prejudices against Yankees, coeducational institutions, and women's higher education. Cheerful and energetic, she enjoys being consulted for advice and takes pride in her active oversight of church and village affairs.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P45](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0045), [v1 c10 P33](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0033), [v1 c15 P84](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0084), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c18 P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 c31 P7](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0007), [v1 c36 P32](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0032), [v1 c38 P31](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0031), [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P48](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0048), [v2 c1 P50](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0050), [v2 c9 P10](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0010), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v3 c2 P23](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0023), [v3 c7 P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016)_

## History

Agatha lived for many years at her home in Brierley with her quiet husband, Thomas Sowerby, where she directed church auxiliary societies, made cotton warp quilts, and kept a sharp eye on village happenings. When orphan Nell Harcourt arrived at Grey Shutters, Agatha visited and made blunt comments about Nell's red hair and freckles, causing Nell to lose her temper at her; after Nell apologized, Agatha readily forgave her. Over the years, Agatha assisted neighbors by making clothing and providing counsel on local issues, while taking top prizes for her butter and cheese. During her husband Thomas's long final illness, she proved to be a tender and devoted nurse until his death. Facing financial difficulties due to an old mortgage on their farm, she sold her property and accepted Thirza Abernethy's invitation to move into Grey Shutters as a resident. At Grey Shutters, she remained deeply involved in church affairs, took part in domestic tasks, and kept a firm hand on the upbringing of young Robin and Lucy.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P0](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0000), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c10 P33](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0033), [v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 c25 P25](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0025), [v1 c29 P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 c30 P0](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0000), [v3 c5 P8](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0008), [v3 c13 P7](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0007), [v3 c13 P55](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0055)_
